name: Alhammarret
description: Alhammarret is a sphinx who mentored Jace in mental techniques, then betrayed and manipulated him and was killed when Jace shattered his mind.

description_citations.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

summary.text: Alhammarret is a sphinx who mentored Jace in mental techniques, then betrayed and manipulated him and was killed when Jace shattered his mind.

citations.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

bio.text: He taught Jace mental techniques such as Oubevir's Maneuver, but meddled with Jace's memory, and Jace was forced to forget his first planeswalks.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.
"The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

bio.text: He made Jace commit crimes and erased his mind.
In a memory of a rooftop fight, Jace's mind-strike collapsed Alhammarret's mind, leaving him screaming like an infant.

citations.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.
"The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Vryn thought Jace had died with Alhammarret, and when Ranna asked if Jace had killed him, his expression answered yes.

bio.text: In a later memory trap he rose again as a nightmare, compelling Garruk and Vraska to step off a rooftop.

timeline.summary: Alhammarret rises and strikes Jace with the full force of his mind.
timeline.quote: Alhammarret rose to his feet, and the full force of his mind hit Jace like a storm front.

citation.text: Clash of Wills (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alhammarret takes Jace as an apprentice at thirteen.
timeline.quote: Alhammarret took Jace from his father and allowed him to become his apprentice at age thirteen.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace learns that his spark ignited a year earlier and that Alhammarret lied to him.
timeline.quote: He discovered that his spark had ignited over a year ago, dipping him into the Blind Eternities only for a moment.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace destroys Alhammarret's mind in rage.
timeline.quote: He slipped into Alhammarret's mind and unleashed all of his rage and pain at once, destroying his master's mind.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the revised origin, Alhammarret is revealed as a sphinx arbitrating between Vryn's warring factions.
timeline.quote: Alhammarret was revealed to be a sphinx who arbitrated between the two warring factions of Vryn.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Revised origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace destroys the sphinx's mind in a telepathic duel and accidentally planeswalks to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: forced Jace to accidentally planeswalk away, landing himself in the streets of Ravnica

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Revised origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees that Jace was forced to forget his first planeswalks and mentally violated every time he remembered.
timeline.quote: the realization he had been forced to forget his first planeswalk

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska experiences Jace's memory of facing the sphinx Alhammarret on a rooftop.
timeline.quote: the sphinx Alhammarret was crouched to attack in front of her.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace's mind-strike collapses Alhammarret's mind in a catastrophic implosion (flashback).
timeline.quote: What was a well of weathered marble violently collapsed against itself in a catastrophic implosion that deafened the senses.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Alhammarret, mind destroyed, screams like an infant.
timeline.quote: It was the terrified howl of an infant.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Only the image of the sphinx's collar symbol remains in Jace's memory.
timeline.quote: All that remained was the image of the sphinx's collar

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace explains Oubevir's Maneuver can hide the gap in Vraska's memories.
timeline.quote: It's a way to smooth over evidence of mental tampering.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in his old bedroom and explains he gave them fevers to burn out phyresis; Ranna reveals Vryn thought he died with Alhammarret.
timeline.quote: We all thought you died with him.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace shows his mother his memories, and she asks if he killed Alhammarret; his expression answers yes.
timeline.quote: Ranna nods for him. " Good ."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Garruk's empathy frees the Clean Slate, an aspect of Jace as an abused child, which he hosts in his mind.
timeline.quote: He hosted the Clean Slate in his mind as the allies moved forward.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Through the next portal the group falls to a rooftop memory in the rain, with Alhammarret's body dying.
timeline.quote: At the center of it all is a gargantuan sphinx.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The sphinx rises again, and the nightmare compels Garruk to jump off the ledge.
timeline.quote: Garruk draws his axe and lurches forward to swing but suddenly knows he needs to turn around

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra reach the portal, but Vraska, compelled by the sphinx, steps off the edge of the building.
timeline.quote: And as easily as one would step off the last stair, she steps over the edge.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Compelled by Alhammarret to step off the Vrynian rooftop, Vraska aims her fall at a portal and steps off.
timeline.quote: She was commanded to walk, but she was not commanded to aim, and so she aims.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: After Alhammarret's death, fighting in the Core States intensifies into chaos and a failed state.
timeline.quote: After the death of the arbiter Alhammarret , the fighting intensified and culminated in non-stop chaos.

citation.text: "Vryn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Jace shattered Alhammarret's mind in self-defense.
relations.quote: Jace reached out defensively with his own mind.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.
